nieuw.titel: Use ambushers to pressure enemy movement before they arrive
nieuw.tekst: Consider ambushers to make opponents reconsider aggressive advances and the space they leave behind. In his experience, a unit held in reserve can influence the battlefield before it arrives.
nieuw.waarom: He found that opponents must consider where ambushers could enter when deciding whether to push forward or advance aggressively down a flank. Ignoring them can expose an otherwise secure backline.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He does not consider ambushing worthwhile for every unit.

bronnen.citaat: It affects whether they go aggressively down a flank or push aggressively straight forward.

nieuw.titel: Favour fast cavalry with high movement as ambushers
nieuw.tekst: He thinks fast cavalry with high movement make the best ambushers.
nieuw.waarom: He values their ability to reach objectives, pressure the backline or threaten charges after arriving.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He does not think ambushing is very useful for many slow infantry units.

bronnen.citaat: think the best ones are fast cavalry with high movement.

nieuw.titel: Use Reserve Move to reposition ambushers on arrival
nieuw.tekst: Value Reserve Move on ambushers and use the extra move on the turn they arrive. It lets them move again after their normal movement, despite being unable to march.
nieuw.waarom: He says the two moves effectively provide a march, letting mobile ambushers reach objectives or set up threats for the following turn.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He describes skirmishing Glade Riders and nomadic Wolf Riders moving 18 inches in their chosen direction after arriving.

bronnen.citaat: An added bonus to that is reserve move

extraCitaten.citaat: at the end of your shooting phase you get to move again

nieuw.titel: Give ambushers banners for combat-resolution support
nieuw.tekst: Consider banners when building ambushers to help swing a stalled combat. He highlights a standard with Close Order, or a standard and War Banner in a skirmishing unit, with a flank or rear charge adding further combat resolution.
nieuw.waarom: He says this static combat resolution can turn a stalemate or help break the opponent.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He used five Wolf Riders with a standard and War Banner to rear-charge Chosen Chaos Knights alongside a chariot. He says their added combat resolution made winning certain where the chariot alone might not have been enough.

bronnen.citaat: Static combat res is great if you have a banner and close order

extraCitaten.citaat: If you have the war banner in there with your banner on a skirmishing unit,
with them it was a certainty.

nieuw.titel: Consider shooting ambushers for immediate impact
nieuw.tekst: Consider shooting when choosing ambushers so they can affect a target immediately on arrival. Move them into short range where possible before firing.
nieuw.waarom: He values being able to deliver a volley at a location of his choice without waiting for a later charge.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that arriving counts as moving and describes a minus-one shooting penalty.

bronnen.citaat: shooting just allows that instant impact at a at a location of your choice.

extraCitaten.citaat: you might be able to get into close range which negates that minus one.

nieuw.titel: Consider 20 Sneaky Gits for backline shooting
nieuw.tekst: Consider 20 ambushing Sneaky Gits to deliver 40 throwing-weapon shots into the enemy backline. He thinks that volume will most likely kill a war machine even at Strength 3.
nieuw.waarom: He highlights their multiple-shot throwing weapons as a way to make the ambush useful immediately.

bronnen.citaat: have 20 of them throw 40 shots into your opponent's backline.

nieuw.titel: Consider Beastmen infantry ambushers for idle objectives
nieuw.tekst: He considers Beastmen an exception to his doubts about infantry ambushers. Bring them on in a safe area and send them to capture an idle objective.
nieuw.waarom: He cites an ability improving their arrival roll, sufficient mobility, their desire to avoid shooting and their Core status.

bronnen.citaat: put them on in a in a safe zone and go and capture

nieuw.titel: Consider Road Wardens for a shooting ambush
nieuw.tekst: He rates Empire Road Wardens as potentially the best shooting ambushers. Use their arrival move to get close to a vulnerable target and fire.
nieuw.waarom: He highlights the combination of movement and repeater pistols, allowing them to arrive and immediately threaten targets with shooting.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His opponent brought on nine Road Wardens, moved into short range and destroyed his Glade Riders in one volley. They then pressured his left flank.

bronnen.citaat: I think maybe the best shooting ambushes in the game

extraCitaten.citaat: Gets right up close to be short range

nieuw.titel: Account for successful ambush rolls when moving vulnerable units
nieuw.tekst: Do not position vulnerable units on the assumption that enemy ambushers will fail their arrival roll. Consider the eight-inch entry restriction when leaving space near those units.
nieuw.waarom: He warns that an opponent who relies on the arrival roll failing can leave a perfect entry point for the ambushers.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He moved his Glade Riders out of a wood to protect them from cannons, overlooking the space left for enemy Road Wardens. The ambushers arrived and destroyed them.

bronnen.citaat: if your opponent is thinking you are going to fail them that roll

extraCitaten.citaat: not considering the 8 in range. I could have played around this.

nieuw.titel: Choose advantageous fights for ambushing Wolf Riders
nieuw.tekst: Be selective about what ambushing Wolf Riders fight and seek an advantage. Do not charge something head-on simply because it is in the way.
nieuw.waarom: He says Wolf Riders are not good in combat and need favourable engagements.

bronnen.citaat: selective on who they fight because they're not good in combat.

extraCitaten.citaat: There's no point in me front on charging something just because they're in the way.

nieuw.titel: Keep fragile flex units safe in ambush reserve
nieuw.tekst: Consider holding a lightly armoured flex unit in ambush reserve to keep it safe from shooting. Bring it on in a safe area from which it can threaten the opponent.
nieuw.waarom: He says these units cannot be shot while off the board and can enter somewhere safe before springing a trap.

bronnen.citaat: when they're not on the board they're not getting shot.

extraCitaten.citaat: come on in an area that is again safe

bron.citaat: They can move 18 inches in close order and they can score objectives

extraCitaten.citaat: I've got uh 15 of them with Kicknik in it

aanvullingen.toelichting: He again recommends ambushing Wolf Riders with Kiknik as mobile Core objective scorers.

overgeslagen: Skipped sponsorship, channel promotion, rules-only explanations and uncertain weapon details. Used the game examples only where they supported clear advice; omitted speculative movement shown only in pictures and garbled combat-description details.
